parameters.name: CredName
parameters.description:
- 01: Personal ID cards
  - 0101: ID card
  - 0102: Bank card
  - 0104: Teacher qualification certificate
  - 0107: Student ID card
- 02: Business scenario
  - 0201: Storefront photo
  - 0202: Counter photo
  - 0203: Scene photo
- 03: Corporate qualifications
  - 0301: Business license

parameters.name: CredType
parameters.description:
Credential type:

- 01: Personal ID cards
- 02: Business scenario
- 03: Corporate qualifications

parameters.name: ImageContext
parameters.description: Base64 encoded image, choose one from `imageUrl`, `imageFile`, or `imageContext`.

parameters.name: ImageFile
parameters.description: Image input stream, choose one from `imageUrl`, `imageFile`, or `imageContext`.

parameters.name: ImageUrl
parameters.description: Image URL, choose one from `imageUrl`, `imageFile`, or `imageContext`.

parameters.name: IsCheck
parameters.description:
Whether to enable authoritative authentication

- ****0****: No
- **1**: Yes

parameters.name: MerchantDetail
parameters.description:
Merchant details:

MerchantName: Merchant name

BusinessType: Industry information

BusinessContent: Business content

This field is required when PromptModel is set to DEFAULT.

parameters.name: MerchantId
parameters.description: Merchant ID. This field is required when ****CredName**** is set to **02**.

parameters.name: ProductCode
parameters.description:
Invocation mode:

- ANTI_FAKE_CHECK: Image anti-forgery check

- ANTI_FAKE_VL: Image anti-forgery check and semantic understanding

- IMAGE_VL_COG: Image semantic understanding

Default value: ANTI_FAKE_CHECK

When CredType is set to 02, ProductCode can only be ANTI_FAKE_VL or IMAGE_VL_COG.

parameters.name: Prompt
parameters.description:
Customer-defined prompt content for image semantic understanding.

This field is required when PromptModel is set to CUSTOM.

parameters.name: PromptModel
parameters.description:
Prompt acquisition method for image semantic understanding:

- DEFAULT: System default

- CUSTOM: Customer-defined

Note: When ProductCode is set to ANTI_FAKE_VL or IMAGE_VL_COG, this parameter must be provided.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudauth credential-verify-v2 --cred-type 01 --cred-name 0104 --image-url http://marry.momocdn.com/avatar/3B/B6/3BB6527E-7467-926E-1048-B43614F20CC420230803_L.jpg --image-file '无' --image-context '无' --is-ocr 0 --is-check 0 --user-name '张三' --identify-num 400000000000000001 --cert-num 460100000 --merchant-id '无。' --product-code ANTI_FAKE_CHECK --prompt-model - --prompt - --merchant-detail Value=- Key=- --api-version 2019-03-07 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cloudauth CredentialVerifyV2 --region cn-hangzhou --MerchantDetail '[{"Value":"-","Key":"-"}]' --ImageFile '无' --UserName '张三' --ProductCode ANTI_FAKE_CHECK --IdentifyNum 400000000000000001 --ImageUrl 'http://marry.momocdn.com/avatar/3B/B6/3BB6527E-7467-926E-1048-B43614F20CC420230803_L.jpg' --MerchantId '无。' --CredName 0104 --IsOcr 0 --PromptModel '-' --CertNum 460100000 --Prompt '-' --IsCheck 0 --CredType 01 --ImageContext '无'
